meta.title: About | Chemical Process Equipment and AX Development
meta.description: H3-Tech designs and builds chemical-resistant parts and custom automation equipment for semiconductor, display, and surface-treatment sites. Explore our manufacturing work and chemical-process AI transformation (AX) development.

intro.title: H3-Tech
intro.subtitle: Chemical process equipment, automation, and AX development
intro.body: We design and build chemical-resistant parts and custom automation equipment for semiconductor, display, and surface-treatment sites. Drawing on our understanding of equipment and operating conditions, we are developing chemical-process AI transformation (AX) technology that uses process data.

domains.title: Parts and equipment for your site
domains.body: We review chemicals, operating conditions, and installation space before agreeing on the scope. Parts supply and equipment fabrication are our current business. Chemical-process AX is in development.

parts.title: Chemical-resistant parts
parts.body: We design and machine parts with materials and geometry optimized for chemical-exposure environments, for repeat supply.

equipment.title: Custom automation equipment
equipment.body: We build and install chemical-process equipment for each site's requirements, covering design, assembly, and control.

ax.title: Chemical-process AX development
ax.body: We are developing a system that analyzes process data and operating conditions with AI to support operational decisions. Its scope and performance will require validation for each process.

strengths.title: From drawings to site requirements
strengths.body: Whether the request is for a single part or an equipment installation, we start by reviewing the scope and site conditions.

tech.title: Design for fabrication and installation
tech.body: We consider design, machining, assembly, and control together. Installation space, connected equipment, and on-site work are discussed as part of the scope.

model.title: Parts for operating conditions
model.body: We review materials and geometry for chemical exposure and intended use. For repeat orders, we check the existing specification and any requested changes.

network.title: Coordinated fabrication
network.body: We coordinate work with automation-equipment manufacturing partners. Fabrication, control, and installation responsibilities are defined during project discussions.

future.title: AX grounded in manufacturing
future.body: Our understanding of equipment and processes informs AI development. We distinguish work in progress from validated results and assess applications step by step.

vision.title: Connecting manufacturing experience with process data and AI
vision.body: Within manufacturing AI transformation, H3-Tech focuses on chemical-process equipment and operating conditions. We are developing technology to collect and analyze process data to support operational decisions.
vision.status: This technology is in development. The stages below describe our development and validation direction, not commercially available capabilities or verified performance improvements. Applicability and collaboration scope require a process-specific review.

p1.label: 01 / DATA
p1.title: Understand the process and data
p1.body: Our direction is to document equipment and operating conditions, identify available data, and determine what is needed for analysis.

p2.label: 02 / TEST
p2.title: Evaluate a limited application
p2.body: We plan to define the problem and evaluation criteria, then validate the analysis approach and applicability using a limited process and dataset.

p3.label: 03 / BUILD
p3.title: Develop further from validated results
p3.body: We plan to improve decision-support functions within the validated scope and assess integration with existing controls and operating procedures.

scope.q: Which industries and processes does H3-Tech work with?
scope.a: We work on chemical-resistant parts and custom automation equipment for sites using process chemicals, including semiconductor, display, and surface-treatment operations. Feasibility depends on the chemicals, temperature, dimensions, and installation conditions.

delivery.q: Can you handle design, fabrication, and installation?
delivery.a: You can consult us on parts design and machining, as well as equipment design, assembly, control, and installation. The delivery scope is agreed after reviewing the work required, partner responsibilities, and site conditions.

ax.q: What stage is your chemical-process AX system at?
ax.a: It is in development. The aim is to analyze process data and operating conditions with AI to support decisions. Commercial availability and performance have not been established. Technical collaboration can be discussed based on the process and available data.

preparation.q: What should I prepare for an equipment inquiry?
preparation.a: Intended use, chemicals and operating conditions, dimensions, quantities, installation space, and your target schedule help us review a request. If drawings are not available, start with site photos and requirements. Agree on the scope and transfer method before sharing confidential or personal information.
